svg.style: background:#FFFFFF; font-family:'Segoe UI', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
svg.text: Academic DBMS Specification | Strong Entities, Weak Entities with Partial Keys, Identifying Relationships, and Participation Constraints
Academic Conceptual ER Notation Reference (Chen Methodology):
Independent entity with autonomous primary key (e.g. USER, BRAND, GARMENT)
Existence-dependent entity identified by owner key + partial key (e.g. GARMENT_SIZE, GARMENT_MEASUREMENT)
Double diamond identifying relationship binding weak entity to strong owner
Primary key attribute indicated by solid underline
Discriminator attribute of weak entity indicated by dashed underline
Computed/derived attribute indicated by dashed oval
Double line indicating Total Participation (mandatory existence dependency)
Single line indicating Partial Participation (optional association)
